title: Lifetime Achievement for German engineer Rainer Marquardt for pioneering power-conversion technology behind electric grids

passages.locator: A milestone in modern power conversion; Engineering the backbone of future energy systems
passages.note: The EPO identifies the 2001 filing and its independently switched, series-connected capacitor submodules and identifies California’s Trans Bay project as an industrial application. The EPO also describes Marquardt’s consulting on early industrial uses without detailing a transfer agreement.
